name: curtain-blind-iso
description: Isolated comparison of window treatments in open floor: closed vs open curtain (open must clear the centre) and lowered vs raised roller blind. Placed in a row in the living/dining room and viewed via focus + top view.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: place-row
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>/living|dining/i.test(x.id))||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+r.width/2, cz=r.origin[1]+r.depth/2; const y=cz; const items=[ {id:'c-closed',defId:'curtains',position:[cx-2.4,y],rotation:0,props:{width:1.6,height:2.6,color:'#9c6b4f',drawAmount:1}}, {id:'c-open',defId:'curtains',position:[cx-0.8,y],rotation:0,props:{width:1.6,height:2.6,color:'#9c6b4f',drawAmount:0}}, {id:'b-down',defId:'roller-blind',position:[cx+0.8,y],rotation:0,props:{width:1.3,height:2.2,drop:1.6,lower:1,color:'#cdd2cc'}}, {id:'b-up',defId:'roller-blind',position:[cx+2.4,y],rotation:0,props:{width:1.3,height:2.2,drop:1.6,lower:0.15,color:'#cdd2cc'}} ]; s.setItems(items); window.__row={cx,cz}; })()
